verdicts.why: Elektra is not a subject until the Elektra stage (the Daredevil (2003) subjects are Blade and Matt Murdock, both active), and at Elektra she is already revived, so 'Active in their own worlds' is true for the box's subjects at every title it covers.
Daredevil: Born Again S3 (set for March 2027) is one of the unreleased titles the owner keeps in the lists on purpose as placeholders.

Wikipedia's episode summary says Castle tells Russo he wanted to protect those close to him 'by pretending to be dead', and he has a grave Hoyle and Russo visit, so 'faking his death' is supported, not a shown error.

Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

verdicts.why: A stage must be true until the next one; the Void holds only Blade, Elektra, Gambit, Laura and Johnny, so the label is false for every later title's subjects. Adding per-title stages keeps D&W's stage and makes each later one true (a box-wide reword like 'abandoned timelines' is not shown on screen for Inhumans, Runaways or Cloak & Dagger).

Cassie rallies Axia's people and, per the plot, the Freedom Fighters and the Quantum Realm's people help defeat Kang while Scott fights him at the front with Cassie and Hope, so 'Scott and Cassie lead the people against him and defeat him' is a fair summary, not a shown error.

Several shorts are off the ship: the Grunds under a rock, the mud bath with a squirrel bird, the egg 'on an alien planet', the snowman on 'a snowy planet' and the sacred seed temple; the fix adds only that.
